//: Every word status.gallafy.com prints. A new language is a copy of this file under its code (hi.json), every key filled; test/render.test.mjs refuses a language file with a key missing or extra. {name} is filled in by lib/render.mjs. A row may have its own line for a state, `component.<id>.line.<state>`, which then replaces `line.<state>`.
meta.title: Gallafy status
meta.description: Is Gallafy working right now? Live checks of the app, your saved records, the website, the GST connection, e-way bills and e-invoicing.
overall.sub.operational: Our last checks found no problem.
overall.sub.degraded: It still works, but may take longer than usual. Details below.
overall.sub.down: Our checks can't reach part of Gallafy. Details below.
overall.sub.maintenance: Some parts may pause while we work. Details below.
overall.sub.unknown: Our checks have not run recently, so we can't say for sure.
stale: Our checks have not run since {time}. What you see below may be out of date.
howWeCheck: We check each part a few times a day, when GitHub runs our scheduled check, from outside Google Cloud, where Gallafy runs. GitHub picks the times, so hours can pass between checks. A part shows as down only after two checks in a row fail.
line.down: Not answering. Two checks in a row failed.
line.declared: We have posted a note about this below.
component.console.name: Gallafy app
component.console.what: Signing in and the app itself, at console.gallafy.com.
component.database.name: Your saved records
component.database.what: Whether the app can reach the database that holds your invoices and books.
component.website.name: Website
component.website.what: gallafy.com, with features, prices and help.
component.gsp.name: GST connection
component.gsp.what: Filing returns and looking up GSTINs go through our GST Suvidha Provider, Sandbox.co.in. We check that Sandbox answers. We can't see the GST portal itself.
component.eway.name: E-way bills
component.eway.what: Making, updating, extending and cancelling e-way bills. We count how many of Gallafy's requests to the e-way bill system failed in the last 15 minutes. When nobody has made one, we only know that Sandbox answers.
component.eway.line.down: Not working. Two checks in a row found e-way bill requests failing, or Sandbox not answering.
component.einvoice.name: E-invoice system (IRP)
component.einvoice.what: Connecting your e-invoice login, and e-way bills made from an e-invoice, go through the IRP. We count how many of Gallafy's requests to it failed in the last 15 minutes. When nobody has made one, we only know that Sandbox answers.
component.einvoice.line.down: Not working. Two checks in a row found requests to the IRP failing, or Sandbox not answering.
component.email.name: Emails we send
component.email.what: Invoices, reminders and account emails. We check that our email service answers.
component.payments.name: Paying for your plan
component.payments.what: Payments for your Gallafy plan go through Razorpay. We check that Razorpay answers.
components.title: What we check
bars.label: The last 90 days
bars.uptime: Up {pct} of the time we checked
bars.counted: We count only the time between checks no more than 15 minutes apart. A day with none is grey and is not counted.
incidents.none: No notes in the last 90 days.
help.title: Still stuck?
help.body: WhatsApp us on {whatsapp} or email {email}. Tell us what you were trying to do.
footer.apart: This page runs apart from Gallafy, so it keeps working when the app does not.
